leftEvidence.title: Jesus speaks of one greater than Solomon

points.label: Solomon-relative action
points.left: Jesus refuses a demanded sign except Jonah’s and says the queen of the south will judge the generation because she came to hear Solomon’s wisdom.
points.right: Jesus calls the generation evil, names Jonah as sign, and says the queen came from the ends of the earth to hear Solomon.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Solomon’s wisdom becomes a witness against those who resist a greater presence.
points.right: Past Gentile response is set against present refusal.

payload.posture: Matthew and Luke preserve the queen’s journey and Jesus’ greater claim within related but distinct narrative arrangements.
payload.tension: Parallel witness supports the claim while preserving each Gospel’s placement and sequence.
payload.title: The greater-than-Solomon saying in two settings
